time_definition: t = TwoTau = 2*tau; microseconds used in this analysis
unit_evidence: Author 2009 thesis: pulse timing in microseconds and NQR inverse T2 in ms^-1, Fig. 11, p.29 of version _5.
echo_amplitude_definition: sqrt(IntRe**2 + IntIm**2); this differs from stored IntQ
main_model: A * exp(-(t/T2e)**beta), zero offset, unweighted amplitude residuals
interpretation: T2e is the effective 1/e envelope time. beta is descriptive. Sensitivity runs are not confidence intervals. No microscopic relaxation mechanism is inferred.

nqr_comparison.numeric_precision: Read as a scale from a figure, not tabulated measurements
